subject: Deploying to update an app creates new instance

messages.author: 483836b71ad61e87
messages.subject: Deploying to update an app creates new instance
parts:
Hi,

I've been looking to update an app I have previously deployed and is currently live. When I go to update from RStudio, upon selecting the app I would like to update from the drop down, it seems to revert to inputting a fresh title/name rather than having it as an "update". When selected, it begins with the dialog box stating update and "getting details for APPNAME", before reverting to inputting a fresh title in for a new app. There are no error messages (that I can see at least) displayed. 

If I then manually type in the name of the app that has already been deployed and attempt to publish, it creates a new instance (if the original was APPNAME, it creates a new app called APPNAME2) rather than updating the older version. 

Any guidance would be very appreciated, if any additional details are required as well I will be happy to supply them.
